bison-1.author: Base Labs
bison-1.disclosure: Hosted API via Baseten Model APIs, served as decision-models/baseten-bison-31b-latest (a -latest alias), measured 21 Nov 2026; not tied to a Hugging Face revision. Reference Hugging Face HEAD at run time: baselabs/bison-1@bf8350b2. Baseten documentation lists 131,072 context tokens, while its management API reported 32,768. Five items of 77–82k input tokens received answers with full reported usage; reported usage is not proof that every token was read. Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers. Baseten retention statements are vendor claims and were not audited.
